title: WSS guide: credential expiry tells client to re-fetch Session object unnecessarily
description: The credential expiry section says to re-fetch the JMAP Session object after re-authenticating in order to get a fresh WebSocket URL. WebSocket URLs do not change between auth refresh cycles. This adds an unnecessary round-trip. The simpler approach is to reconnect to the known URL with new credentials and only re-fetch the Session object if that connection fails. Implementers following the guide as written will add latency to every credential refresh cycle.
